note: bisection over S73 space state only; interpreter-step bisection is OUT of scope (S68 RED, blocked upstream on hyperon Issue 3)

controls.name: C_state_root_cannot_separate_histories
controls.must_fire_because: a state root is a function of the space, so it cannot distinguish the history that produced it; the chain must
controls.can_fail_because: the two groupings give different STATE roots (S73 would already bind history), or equal CHAIN roots (the chain adds nothing)
controls.null_must_contain: two epoch groupings of one atom set, which reach the same state root by construction
controls.detail: state roots equal, chain roots differ

controls.name: C_chain_binds_all_three
controls.must_fire_because: dropping root_prev lets a prover splice onto another history; dropping the delta lets it claim a transition it never made; dropping root_next says nothing about where it arrived
controls.can_fail_because: an omitted input still separates the two groupings, i.e. that input was never binding
controls.null_must_contain: the same two groupings C1 uses, which a complete link separates and a crippled one must not
controls.detail: each crippled link must still separate the groupings

controls.name: C_forged_sequence_rejected
controls.must_fire_because: a prover must not present a real state root reached by a route it invented
controls.can_fail_because: the chain accepts a claim whose declared additions were never the ones applied
controls.null_must_contain: an honest chain over g1, which must verify, so a rejection is not vacuous

controls.name: C_referee_does_not_reexecute
controls.must_fire_because: a dispute must cost O(log N) rounds and ONE executed epoch, or it has saved nothing over re-execution
controls.can_fail_because: steps_verified > 1 at any N, or rounds exceeding ceil(log2 N)
controls.null_must_contain: N from 8 to 128, a 16x range, so a linear referee would be plainly visible
controls.detail: rounds vs ceil(log2 N) vs epochs executed

controls.name: C_localises_every_epoch
controls.must_fire_because: the referee must return exactly the planted epoch for every epoch, including 0 and N-1
controls.can_fail_because: any planted epoch is not the epoch returned
controls.null_must_contain: all N planted positions, not a sample -- an interior-only sweep cannot see a boundary bug

controls.name: C_w2_empty_space_has_no_root
controls.must_fire_because: GENESIS_ROOT is a LOCAL convention and is only needed while W2 has no canonical root for the empty space
controls.can_fail_because: W2.build([]) returning a root instead of raising IndexError -- i.e. upstream closed the gap and W5's local genesis constant is now a divergence
controls.null_must_contain: a canonical root for the empty space -- W2 returning any digest from build([]) is the outcome this control must be able to observe, and it is one line of upstream change away
controls.detail: W2 trie_witness.build([]) on the empty key set

falsifier: if the referee must execute more than one epoch, or rounds exceed ceil(log2 N), bisection saves nothing over re-execution and the dispute path is decorative
